blocks.raw: <Tip>**Day Care Anchors:** Group C occupancy (not B or D). DSWD regulatory authority (not DepEd). Activity room = 1.5 sqm/child, max 25/room. Outdoor play = equal to indoor activity area. Nap room = 0.9–1.2 sqm/child. Child toilet = 250–300 mm; child lavatory = 550–600 mm. Exit width = 7.6 mm/child. Dual exits at 50+.</Tip>
